# CCMAF Skills — Backend & APIs (`ccmaf-skills-backend`)

Services and the contracts between them: HTTP and GraphQL API design, .NET, Go and Rust, relational SQL, identity and auth, and event-driven architecture.

**Audience:** Backend and full-stack developers building services and data access.

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add drushegh/CCMAF---Skills
/plugin install ccmaf-skills-backend@ccmaf-skills
```

Install `ccmaf-skills-core` alongside this pack.
